decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric sits close to the core offer, had its own page as a visible public commitment, and is still young enough that weak results can be blamed on market ramp-up.

The bouclé-effect decorative fabric fits the established range, but it had only a light website presence and little public commitment, so it is the most exposed to a routine collection refresh, though persistence still prevails.
The flame-retardant jacquard reflects certification and development investment for contract and hospitality customers and had its own page, so management will strongly persist with it.
The double-face wool-blend fabric uses renewable fiber in line with the announced sustainability direction, which justifies keeping it despite modest visibility.
The wool bouclé leno required development effort and supports the shift to renewable materials, so slow uptake will be read as temporary.
The braided-structure fabric was launched only in 2024 with its own page, so recent investment and public commitment make dropping it very unlikely.
